args.message: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212. The previous implementation imported and used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly tests in tests/test_money.py to fail. Verified with test cases: 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 (banker's rounding).

args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py`'s `round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring specifying banker's rounding per FIN-212. This mismatch caused `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build.
- Changed the import and `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Test plan
- `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` asserts `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66` (banker's rounding behavior); verified against the new implementation.
- Full CI run completed successfully on commit 08d3cd5986.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
